about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it's in our own garden — safe, fair, and properly done.
about_para_1: UKSAS Special Arborist Service was founded on the principle that tree work should be honest, transparent, and done right the first time. With nearly two decades of experience across Southampton and the New Forest, we've built our reputation on safe practices, fair pricing, and genuine expertise. Every team member is fully trained, insured, and committed to leaving your garden in better shape than we found it.
about_para_2: Homeowners and business owners trust us because we listen first, quote fairly, and always explain what needs doing and why. We've handled everything from clearing storm damage overnight to carefully felling heritage trees with sensitivity to the surrounding landscape. Our customers come back because we're reliable, respectful of their property, and we actually finish the job when we say we will.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was threatening the garage after a storm. These lads came out the same day, assessed it properly, quoted fairly, and the work was done in two days. Careful, professional, and left the place spotless. Really can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using UKSAS for hedge trimming and tree maintenance for three years now. They're punctual, reasonably priced, and actually know what they're doing. The garden looks brilliant every time. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out when a branch fell during a gale. They came straight away, made it safe, cleared everything up, and didn't try to oversell unnecessary work. That's the mark of a decent tradesman. Five stars.
reviews.author: David P.
